Overflow Values

Visible (default) - content overflows

This content is larger than its container and should overflow visibly.

Hidden - content clipped

This content is larger than its container and should be clipped/hidden.

Scroll - scrollbars always visible

This content has scrollbars always visible, even if content fits. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.

Auto - scrollbars when needed

This content shows scrollbars only when needed. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor.

Overflow-X hidden, Overflow-Y visible

Horizontal overflow hidden, vertical visible.

Overflow-X visible, Overflow-Y hidden

Horizontal overflow visible, vertical hidden.
